pins.name: TXD
pins.description: Transmit Data output (UART serial output to MCU RXD)

pins.name: RXD
pins.description: Receive Data input (UART serial input from MCU TXD, 5V tolerant)

pins.name: V3
pins.description: 3.3V Regulator bypass (100nF cap to GND in 5V mode; tie to VCC in 3.3V mode)

pins.name: CTS#
pins.description: Clear To Send modem control input (Active LOW)

pins.name: DSR#
pins.description: Data Set Ready modem control input (Active LOW)

pins.name: RI#
pins.description: Ring Indicator modem control input (Active LOW)

pins.name: DCD#
pins.description: Data Carrier Detect modem control input (Active LOW)

pins.name: DTR#
pins.description: Data Terminal Ready modem control output (Active LOW, for MCU auto-reset)

pins.name: RTS#
pins.description: Request To Send modem control output (Active LOW)

pins.name: RS232
pins.description: Auxiliary control pin (Tie LOW for normal UART mode)
